newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt court backs transsexual inheritor.
newsitem.headline: Egypt court backs transsexual inheritor.

text.p: A court in Alexandria rejected a bid by the son of a millionaire to reduce the inheritance of his brother who had undergone a sex-change operation, a government newspaper said on Sunday.
The son's argument was based on Islamic law, which states a male inherits double the amount of a female.
But al-Akhbar newspaper said the sibling proved to the court she was a man at the time of the father's death and so could share equally in his estate.
The paper said she underwent the operation after the father's death and had since married. Sex change operations are rare in Egypt.
